product_metadata.title: 1 X Indian Maiden with Wolves Walking Dream Catcher 13 Inches
features: 13" double dream catcher featuring an Indian Maiden with Wolves
Includes hanging string with feathers and beads
description: This 13" double dream catcher features an Indian Maiden with Wolves. A smaller 5" dream catcher hangs below the main one. Painted canvas picture measures 10". Authentic looking dream catcher is adorned with beads and feathers. Great gift for any Native American collector. Note: This item is not an Indian product or an Indian produced item as defined by 26 USA-305 et Seq or by the Indian Arts and Crafts Act of 1990 (18 U.S.C. 1159, 25 U.S.C. 305 et seq.)
